hero.headline: Transform Your Fitness Journey
hero.subtitle: Personalized workouts, nutrition plans and progress tracking in one modern platform.

features.headline: Built for serious results
features.subtitle: Every feature is designed around one goal — helping you and your coach work better together.

workoutPrograms.title: Workout Programs
workoutPrograms.description: Structured multi-week training plans built by certified coaches. Adapt intensity, volume, and rest to your schedule.

nutritionPlans.title: Nutrition Plans
nutritionPlans.description: Macro-balanced meal plans aligned with your goal — cut, bulk, or maintain. Automatically adjusts as your weight changes.

progressTracking.title: Progress Tracking
progressTracking.description: Log body measurements, upload progress photos, and visualise trends across weeks and months with clear charts.

aiCoach.title: AI Coach
aiCoach.description: Chat with an AI fitness assistant that knows your program, your recent metrics, and your goals to give contextual advice.

mealPlanning.title: Meal Planning
mealPlanning.description: Build weekly meal plans from a library of 500,000+ foods. Auto-generate shopping lists for any date range.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Coaches get compliance dashboards. Clients get volume, streak, and body-composition trend reports — all in one view.

pricing.headline: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start for free. Upgrade when you're ready. No hidden fees.

pro.name: Pro
pro.description: Everything you need to reach your goals.

footer.tagline: The modern platform for coaches and athletes who are serious about results.
footer.builtWith: Built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS.
